svg.title: Same workload, lower overhead
svg.desc: Three complete single-worker matched-WebKit pairs measured 1.32–1.47× more successful tasks/second and 81.97–83.57% lower sampled peak physical footprint. Both arms completed all 80 measured tasks and warmups in each repeat under the same 2 GiB guard. The footprint includes the daemon and responsibility-attributed WebKit/GPU/network helpers. These are project-authored localhost fixture measurements, not general website performance.
